column1: Intel, a leader in the semiconductor industry, is shaping the data-centric future with computing and communications
technology that is the foundation of the world’s innovations. The company’s engineering expertise is helping address the
world’s greatest challenges as well as helping secure, power, and connect billions of devices and the infrastructure of the
smart, connected world—from the cloud to the network to the edge and everything in between.
